 Updated: 11:00 AM EST Nov 1, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jason Newton News Anchor BALTIMORE — As Election Day nears, voters who have yet to cast a ballot early or by mail have some big issues to consider, from Maryland's next governor — an election rematch between incumbent Democrat Gov. Wes Moore and Republican challenger Dan Cox — to Question 3 on redistricting.
 Check out the WBAL-TV Voter's Guide and the Maryland State Board of Elections website to help you prepare.
